items.title: Qi Cultivation Starting From The Repair Panel
items.synopsis: Chu Zheng wakes to find himself no longer a cultural relic restorer but a household slave in a world of qi cultivation. He soon discovers a mysterious Repair Panel within his body that refreshes daily, letting him mend broken mantras, ruined relics, and damaged spirit roots into powerful cultivation treasures. Amid an era of fierce prodigies and competing heroes, he seeks not immortality, but a name history will remember.
items.synopsis_original:
Having opened his eyes once more, Chu Zheng found the world turned upside down. He had transformed from a Cultural Relic Restorer into a household slave.

At the same time, a new feature had emerged within his body: a Repair Panel that refreshed daily, enabling his skills to continuously advance.

【Incomplete Mantra (repairable)】→【Great Circulatory Breathing Guideline】

【Ruined Temple Remnant (repairable)】→【Ancestral Dao Golden Body】

【Damaged Spirit Root (repairable)】→【Superior Quality Immortal Bone】

…………

In an era of cultivating truth, heroes compete fiercely, and prodigies rise together.

From ancient times, sages and wise men were buried by the sands of time; a lifetime of glory or disgrace turned to naught in a blink, and only a few names are recorded in the annals of history.

Having lived this life a second time, Chu Zheng did not seek the arts of immortality, but merely wished to have his name remembered by future generations.

extra.webnovel_matched_title: Qi Cultivation Starting from the Repair Panel

items.title: Parasite Breeding Longveity Path: Starting From Breeding The Love Obsession Parasite
items.synopsis: A single path unfolds through Gu cultivation: the Spring Autumn Gu grants longevity and immortality, the Golden Cicada Gu can revive the dead and regrow flesh and bone, the Dragon Elephant Gu bestows invulnerable power. But the protagonist's very first cultivated insect is the Obsession Gu, and from that strange beginning, an unexpected road to immortality and an enduring family legacy opens before him.
items.synopsis_original:
Cultivating the Spring Autumn Gu can prolong his life and bestow immortality.

Cultivating the Golden Cicada Gu grants the ability to revive the dead and regenerate flesh and bone.

Cultivating the Dragon Elephant Gu gives him the Power of Dragon Elephant and the Dragon Elephant’s Body, making him invulnerable.

Yet, the first Gu Insect he cultivates happens to be the Obsession Gu.

From then on, he discovers a broad path of cultivation.

As time changes and landscapes shift, the only constants are my eternal life and the everlasting Zhou family.

items.title: One Piece: So What If I Sin, Lie, And Lust? I'm Still A Good Marine
items.synopsis: Rogers Daren, Admiral of the North Blue and self-proclaimed "scum of the Marines," faces an internal Navy hearing over his scandalous conduct: affairs with princesses and noble ladies, absurd salaries for his fleet, Germa 66 military technology in his ships, and a suspiciously convenient Celestial Dragon death. He deflects every accusation with shameless charm, unbothered by scrutiny, as his unconventional career in the Marines unfolds.
items.synopsis_original:
During an internal Navy hearing, the top brass conducted a serious inquiry into Rogers Daren, the so-called “scum of the Marines” and Admiral of the North Blue.

“You’ve had improper relations with royal princesses and noble ladies from multiple North Blue kingdoms?”

“I call it showing care for the people.”

Marines High Command: …

“How do you explain the absurdly high salaries of the North Blue Marines under your command?”

“Well, with what the HQ pays, how else do you expect them to risk their lives?”

Marines High Command: (ーー`)

“Why is the North Blue fleet equipped with technology from Germa?”

“That’s just military-civilian cooperation. Germa 66 was moved by my sense of justice.”

Marines High Command: (○_○)

“And how do you explain the unusual deaths of a Celestial Dragon in the North Blue?”

Daren sighed.

“A maritime accident… truly unfortunate. I personally express my deepest condolences.”

Marines High Command: (._.?)

And so begins the story of a rebellious, unorthodox Marine.

items.title: One Piece: Lightning's Heir
items.synopsis: Arthur washes up on Jaya's brutal shores in 1493, unwilling to remain weak in the world of One Piece. Five grueling years of physical and mental preparation follow, all aimed at one goal: claiming the Rumble-Rumble Fruit. He rides the monstrous Knock-Up Stream, then spends a year searching before finding a colossal ship buried in the White-White Sea, holding the prize he's obsessed over.
items.synopsis_original:
Arthur found himself on the brutal shores of Jaya in the year 1493. He was not content with weakness in the world of One Piece; he craved Strength.

...

Five years of relentless preparation, of physical and mental torment, transformed him. all in pursuit of one singular goal: the Rumble-Rumble Fruit.

He defied the odds, riding the monstrous Knock-Up Stream.

A year of tireless searching led him to a forgotten relic, a colossal ship swallowed by the White-White Sea, a testament to a bygone era. And within its depths, he found the object of his obsession.

items.title: No More Pain For This Villain.
items.synopsis: Cornered in an underground basement, a man dies at an old man's blade, his final defiance swallowed by darkness. He wakes seated in a noisy tavern, facing a furious, beautiful woman who spits "Don't follow me around!" before storming off. Disoriented, he begins to suspect he's been dropped inside a game, his understanding of reality crumbling around him.
items.synopsis_original:
...

[Inside an underground basement]

“You are going to die for nothing, hahahaha,” the old man's voice thundered through the room, sending chills down my spine.

Step.

With a swift and ruthless motion, he lunged forward, his sword slicing through the air and slashing my throat, crimson droplets staining the darkness.

“We'll see,” I whispered defiantly, my final words escaping as a mere breath against the impending darkness.

Slowly, inexorably, my consciousness slipped away, and I descended into a deep, unfathomable slumber.

“Huh!?” My eyes fluttered open, and I found myself seated in a bustling tavern, the air thick with laughter and the clinking of glasses.

In front of me stood a captivating lady, her beauty juxtaposed with an angry furrow upon her brow, threatening to shatter the harmony of the jovial scene.

“Don't follow me around!” Her words pierced the air like shards of ice, the intensity of her emotions palpable as she cast a resentful glare in my direction, before swiftly departing from the tavern.

...

Am I trapped within the confines of a game? The fragments of my shattered common sense scattered before me, leaving me to question the very fabric of my reality.

extra.webnovel_matched_title: No More Pain For This Villain.

items.synopsis_original:
It’s also the dividing line between reality and illusion.

Steel and flesh, past and future.

In this place, the world outside and inside coexist. Everything in front of us feels like a wall of time within reach.

The darkness is slowly creeping in.

But hey, my friend, you gotta know, we can’t just counter darkness with softness.

Gotta use fire.

items.title: My Medical Skills Give Me Experience Points
items.synopsis: Zhou Can, an intern at Tu Ya Hospital, counts every stitch he sutures, chasing three hundred today to secure a House Officer position. After his hundred-thousandth suture, a mysterious EXP system awakens, granting him experience points for medical skills and surgical practice. Baffled but intrigued, he watches an interface appear, ranking his pathology diagnosis ability far beyond his intern status, marking the start of his rise toward surgical legend.
items.synopsis_original:
"201th, 202nd…"

Zhou Can, an Intern of Tu Ya Hospital, a Grade A Provincial Tertiary Hospital, would silently count every stitch he finished.

His target today was to complete 300 stitches and fight for a place in the House Officer recruitment two days later.

[Congratulations on completing your 100,000th suture and triggering the EXP system. Medical skills and surgery practice can be obtained.]

Zhou Can shook his head hard.

What the hell is this?

Something even more magical happened as he thought about it.

An interface appeared in front of him.

[Zhou Can, Intern.]

[Pathology Diagnosis, Level Two. Current EXP: 89.5/100. Outstanding House Officer-level diagnosis ability.]

A surgical legend was in the making.

items.synopsis: The Mu family's disgraced prodigal returns, reborn with a divine artifact that grants foresight, earning her fame as the world's greatest diviner. Wielding treasures and magic, she sets out to repay old debts and settle old grudges, reshaping her fate on her own terms. But amid her rise to power, one man's presence proves harder to calculate than heaven and earth combined.
items.synopsis_original:
The first prodigal of the Mu family has returned from rebirth, changing the very colors of heaven and earth, rewriting the entire world.

Possessing divine treasures and magical weapons, she is all-powerful. With debts of vengeance to settle and debts of gratitude to repay! Whether to walk sideways or upright, the posture is a free choice!

Reborn with a divine artifact, she possesses foresight, attracting good fortune and avoiding disaster, earning her the title of the greatest diviner!

The greatest diviner, with the swirling changes of the world in her palm. However, upon encountering that person, she is unable to control her own heart.

“You calculate the heavens and the earth, but have you ever calculated my feelings for you?” A smile blooms on that person's handsome face, as if a deity has descended.

The Mu family's prodigal son, reborn and overturning chaos. Only when he stands at the pinnacle do people realize this isn't the prodigal son, but the breathtakingly beautiful young lady! Many young talents beat their chests in regret, having missed the best opportunity to win the lady's favor.

Yet that person smirks arrogantly, indulging in a tender kiss on her forehead: “Thank you for being blind to her worth, otherwise, how could I have such a beauty in my embrace?”

items.title: King Of Creation
items.synopsis: Ye Zhen wakes one day able to understand the speech of beasts and insects, and the mountains around him are never quiet again. Mice plot over hidden treasure, mosquitoes scheme their next feast, and a young Cloud Winged Tiger bluffs its way through fear with empty roars. Hearing every creature's true intentions turns Ye Zhen's ordinary life upside down.
items.synopsis_original:
Overnight, young Ye Zhen suddenly discovered he had acquired a strange new ability!
The meaningless cries of animals and insects in the mountains entering his ears began to sound quite different.
“Quick, brother,” squeaked the mouse brothers, “the treasure in the back hill that can make us grow dozens of times in size is about to drop, let’s go!”
A swarm of mosquitoes buzzed, “Those two guys are here again, brothers, let’s get them and have a feast!”
A Cloud Winged Young Tiger faced Ye Zhen and let out one fearsome roar after another, “Mommy’s not home, don’t come any closer, come any closer and I’ll eat you!”
Everything changed because of this!

items.title: Interstellar Number One Farmer: I Only Want To Farm!
items.synopsis: Su Xiaocai crossed over from a war-torn interstellar world a decade ago, where alien invasions left front-line soldiers starved for greenery. That hardship sparked her love of planting vegetables and trees, and her dream of becoming the galaxy's greatest farmer, far from any battlefield. But her uncanny mecha skills keep drawing attention, and school authorities seem determined to drag her back toward combat instead.
items.synopsis_original:
Su Xiaocai has crossed over from a more technologically advanced interstellar world for ten years.

In that world, aliens invaded, and wars were frequent. As a warrior on the front line, it was rare to see green plants.

This fostered Su Xiaocai's hobby of planting vegetables and trees.

She vowed to become the best vegetable farmer, far from the battlefield.

Classmates: Who's operating the mecha dancing in the field?

The teacher who heard the rumor rushed over: Not bad, a good seedling.

The principal waved his pen: Transfer her to the Mecha Department.

extra.webnovel_matched_title: Interstellar Number One Farmer: I Only Want To Farm!

items.title: Inheriting A Divine Cultivation Clan At The Start, All My Juniors Are Empresses
items.synopsis: Wei Chi transmigrates into the Celestial Realm's Nine Continents planning to live quietly as a family's third son, until circumstances force him to inherit an entire divine cultivation clan. From then on he starts recruiting talented girls with a simple pitch about cultivation. Ten million years later, those recruits return as formidable empresses, descending on him while he protests that he's taught them everything he knows.
items.synopsis_original:
Wei Chi transmigrated to the Nine Continents of the Celestial Realm. Initially, he was prepared to just be an honest third son of a family. However, after a turn of events, he had no choice but to inherit an entire divine cultivation plan.

From then onward, his vibe changed a little.

When he saw a girl with decent talents, he immediately asked, “Girl, are you interested in divine cultivation?”

In the blink of an eye, 10 million years had passed.

Numerous top-class empresses flew through the sky and showed up in front of Wei Chi.

Wei Chi wailed and yelled,

“I really don’t have any more cultivation methods!”

“Please stop coming here!”

“You’re all grown-ups now!”

items.title: I Just Wanted To Be A Galactic Hunter—Why Am I On The Wanted List?
items.synopsis: Mr. Loren is an infamous outlaw of the interstellar era, uninterested in wealth, women, or the usual vices of criminals—terror is his only pleasure, and he savors it. He surfaces wherever chaos erupts, usually because he caused it, earning a reputation as a refined yet deranged gentleman and a lone symbol of the era's discarded dangers. As an Esper wielding a lethal, ornate revolver, he outmatches cultivators, martial artists, and mecha pilots alike, leaving the Federation with nothing but bitter warnings never to challenge him.
items.synopsis_original:
He has no thirst for wealth. He holds no interest in women. He possesses none of the twisted vices common to the other dregs of society. His sole passion is orchestrating acts of terror, from which he derives sincere pleasure.

He always appears in the galaxy’s most dangerous and spectacular locations, only... usually, he himself is the cause of that danger.

The Interstellar Gazette once wrote of him: "Mr. Lauren is a respectable yet mad gentleman, at times conducting himself like an aristocrat of a bygone era. A lone wolf, he has become a living symbol of the thousands of dangerous individuals cast aside to the margins of progress."

If you are unfortunate enough to cross paths with Mr. Lauren, pray that luck is on your side and that he is in high spirits. Perhaps he will show mercy and let you go.

And remember the most important rule!

Under no circumstances should you ever attempt to use force against him. It matters not who you are—an immortal "Cultivator," an invincible "Martial Artist," or even the darling of the era, a "Mecha Pilot." The Federation strongly advises against it.

For Mr. Lauren is an "Esper," and his abilities are as mysterious as they are lethal. And his luxurious revolver, as proved by the Federation’s countless bitter lessons, brings but one thing—despair.

***

Alternative Synopsis:

[Invincible] + [No Power Scaling Bottleneck] + [No Female Lead] + [Urban Superpowers] + [Interstellar Era] + [Western Fantasy] + [Eastern Cultivation]

As an “unlawful citizen” in the interstellar era, Mr. Loren is considered an exceptional example—a model criminal, if you will.

He doesn’t crave money.

He’s not obsessed with beauty.

Nor does he have the twisted hobbies of other criminals.

No, Mr. Loren has only one passion: acts of terror.

And he takes great joy in them.

He is frequently spotted in places of extreme danger and chaos—

though most of that chaos was probably his doing in the first place.

According to a past feature in the Interstellar Daily:

“Mr. Loren is a refined yet utterly deranged gentleman.

At times, he even carries the demeanor of an old-world aristocrat.”

But as a mad galactic hunter who’s always flying solo,

Loren also symbolizes the countless dangerous individuals discarded by this era.

If any Federation citizen is unfortunate enough to encounter him—

may luck be on your side.

And may Mr. Loren happen to be in a merciful mood.

Most importantly—

do not, under any circumstance, engage Mr. Loren in combat.

Whether you are a cultivator, a martial artist,

or even a mecha pilot—one of this era’s so-called “favorites”—

it’s strongly advised you do not try to fight him.

As an Esper, Mr. Loren’s danger level is both mysterious and fatal.

And if you’ve heard the Federation’s tragic past records,

you’ll know just how terrifying his ornate revolver truly is…

In the Great Cosmic Era, Martial Arts no longer exist, and the path of the Immortal Dao is severed. In their place are giant ships and grand cannons, and genetic leaps.

Wang Xiao was born in this era and inherited his family's Martial Arts Hall.

items.title: I Become Baby Mafia Boss

items.synopsis_original:
Suddenly becomes a mafia boss in a superpowers world and you are only 3 years old?!

Ainsley Sloan, a 20-year-old avid anime lover, suddenly transmigrated into a body of a toddler.

The father eloped with a woman, and the mother was just a surrogate mom. The two left behind their 3-years-old baby girl to rule over a mid-sized mafia family!

No, this can’t be!

Ainsley was forced to embrace the abandoned Sloan Family and bring their family to the top of the dangerous mafia world– else she died.

But, worry not!

With the power of ultimate luck, the help of her loyal subordinates, and the protection of her cats-becoming-human, Ainsley will kick any enemies coming her way!

A late encounter with a certain system even paved a flowery path for her. With its help, Ainsley will be the best mafia boss, and an extraordinary one!

When other mafia bosses smoke cigarettes, Ain has choco Pocky stuck in her mouth.

When other bosses swirl their glass of red wine, Ain blows her cup of hot milk!

When other bosses blow their gun after a fight...Ain changes her diaper.

Watch the baby take over the mafia world with her unique baby charm!

7 years later.
